meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当容器代理出问题时，Claude会按照调试指南逐步排查：先查看主机错误日志，再检查会话的进出数据库以判断消息是否到达容器、回复是否生成，并处理重复实例、认证失败、挂载异常等常见故障。
howto.when: 当容器不工作、启动失败或认证出错时触发；也可用于了解容器系统工作原理。

say.text: 容器代理不回复，帮我查错误日志和会话数据库。
检查是不是有重复的nanoclaw服务在运行？
say.note: 处理消息被静默丢失的问题。

say.text: 帮我重启这个会话的容器。

howto.what_en: When container agent issues arise, Claude follows the debugging guide: checks host error logs, inspects session inbound/outbound DBs to see if messages reached the container and replies were produced, and addresses common issues like duplicate instances, auth failures, and mount problems.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a container is not working, fails to start, or has authentication errors; also used to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container agent isn't replying; check the error logs and session DBs.
say_en.note: Claude checks logs and DBs per the debug steps.

say_en.text: Check if there are duplicate nanoclaw service instances running.
say_en.note: Addresses the silent message loss issue.

say_en.text: Restart the container for this session.
